title: A Neighborhood Attention Transformer Network for Enhanced 3D Segmentation of the Left Anterior Descending Artery
abstract: arXiv:2608.12274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Accurate segmentation of the Left Anterior Descending (LAD) artery in 3D free-breathing, non-contrast CT is critical for cardiac dose sparing in thoracic radiotherapy. The LAD is extremely small, has poor soft-tissue contrast, and varies substantially across patients; even manual contours show limited inter-observer agreement, underscoring the ambiguity of the vessel boundaries. Purpose: To develop a transformer-based framework that improves LAD delineation in low-contrast, imbalanced CT through local-global context modeling and uncertainty-guided optimization. Methods: We propose NA-UNETR, a 3D transformer-based segmentation model whose Neighborhood Attention (NA) and Dilated NA (DiNA) blocks jointly capture fine structural detail and long-range context. Given the scarcity of annotated LAD data, the model is pretrained on 1,000 CTA volumes of general coronary anatomy and fine-tuned with LoRA-based parameter-efficient adapt

translated_title: 一种用于左前降支动脉增强3D分割的邻域注意力Transformer网络
translated_abstract: 摘要：背景：在3D自由呼吸、非对比CT中准确分割左前降支（LAD）动脉对于胸部放疗中的心脏剂量保护至关重要。LAD动脉非常细小，软组织对比度差，且在不同患者间差异显著；即使手动勾画，观察者间的一致性也有限，这凸显了血管边界的模糊性。目的：开发一种基于Transformer的框架，通过局部-全局上下文建模和不确定性引导优化，改善低对比度、不平衡CT中的LAD勾画。方法：我们提出NA-UNETR，一种基于3D Transformer的分割模型，其邻域注意力（NA）和膨胀邻域注意力（DiNA）模块共同捕获精细结构细节和长程上下文。鉴于标注LAD数据的稀缺性，模型在1,000个冠状动脉解剖CTA体积上进行预训练，并通过基于LoRA的参数高效适配进行微调。
tldr: 本文提出NA-UNETR模型，利用邻域注意力和膨胀邻域注意力模块，结合预训练和LoRA微调，有效解决了低对比度CT中左前降支动脉的精确3D分割难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NA-UNETR, a transformer-based model with neighborhood and dilated neighborhood attention, enhanced by pretraining and LoRA fine-tuning, to accurately segment the left anterior descending artery in low-contrast CT.
